defaultContent.title: How LineScanner sees what others miss
defaultContent.title-0-0: How LineScanner sees what others miss
defaultContent.tabs-1-0:
Telecentric light — uniform illumination independent of glass position. Linear image sensor scanning line-by-line at full production speed.

Low-contrast detection: identifies defects 8-bit systems cannot see. Every pixel is equal — no variation by position.

Camera-based systems capture snapshots. LineScanner scans every millimetre continuously — no missed zones, no motion blur.
